description: dryvist/.github nix-manager opt-in preset. Nix repos extend `local>dryvist/.github:renovate-nix` to get the full org default policy PLUS Renovate's native `nix` manager (flake.lock input updates).

The nix manager is intentionally OFF in the default preset: nearly every dryvist repo carries a devshell flake.nix, and enabling it everywhere would churn dev-only lockfiles. Use this preset only for repos whose flake inputs are real, tracked dependencies.
